title: Deduplicate seedProfile/seedProfileZero between test/helpers/drift_memory.dart and test/helpers/test_database.dart
why: Two files under test/helpers/ define an identically-named seedProfile(UserDatabase) — and seedProfileZero — with near-identical bodies (same fixture email, tier, displayName). Three of my four batch files import it interchangeably from either helper. If either copy is fixed or extended (e.g. a new required column) without the other, tests silently diverge on what 'a seeded profile' means depending on which import a test author happened to copy — the same 'divergent parallel copies' failure AG-4 targets for lib/, reproduced in test/helpers/.
recommendation: Keep one implementation (drift_memory.dart looks like the more focused, Drift-specific home) and have test_database.dart re-export or delegate to it; repoint all story_acceptance imports at the single source.
acceptance_criteria: Only one definition of seedProfile and one of seedProfileZero exist under learning_tracker/test/helpers/
grep -rn 'Future<void> seedProfile(' learning_tracker/test/helpers/ returns exactly one match per function name
